== Notes ==
* The hex will apply even if the interruption effect is prevented.
* This skill causes a net energy loss of <font color=green>'''2.67...6...6.67'''</font color> if it lasts its full duration.

== Trivia ==
* Flux is a term describing the rate of flow of something through a surface.
* The woman in the [[skill icon]] seems to also appear in [[Power Leech]]'s skill icon.
